examples.arabic: بعد ساعات طويلة اصبح الطبق جاهزا والرائحة كانت شهية جدا
examples.english: After long hours, the dish was ready, and the smell was very delicious.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da sa'at tawilah asbaha at-tabaq jahizan wa ar-ra'ihah kanat shahiyyah jiddan.

examples.arabic: الطبق بدا جميلا جدا والوانه زاهية
examples.english: The dish looked very beautiful and its colors were bright.
examples.transliteration: At-tabaq bada jamilan jiddan wa alwanuhu zahiyah.

examples.arabic: بعد ان ذاقت قالت نعم يعجبني هذا الطبق جدا
examples.english: After she tasted, she said, "Yes, I really like this dish."
examples.transliteration: Baʿda an dhāqat qālat naʿam yuʿjibunī hādhā aṭ-ṭabaqu jiddan.

examples.arabic: سارة اجابت مساء النور يا جدتي انا بخير لكن الطبق جديد
examples.english: Sara replied Good evening grandmother I am fine but the dish is new.
examples.transliteration: Sara ajabat masa' an-nur ya jaddati ana bi-khayr lakinna at-tabaq jadid.
examples.storyTitle: The New Dish and the Grandmother

examples.arabic: بعد ساعة من العمل كان الطبق جاهزاً والطعم شهياً جداً
examples.english: After an hour of work, the dish was ready and the taste was very delicious.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da sa'ah min al-'amal kana al-tabaq jahizan wa al-ta'm shahiyan jiddan.

examples.arabic: وبعد ساعات من العمل ظهر الطبق التقليدي بشكل شهي ونكهة رائعة
examples.english: After hours of work, the traditional dish appeared delicious with a wonderful flavor
examples.transliteration: Wa baʿda sāʿāt min al-ʿamal ẓahara aṭ-ṭabaqu at-taqlīdī bi-shaklin shahī wa nakhatin rā'iʿah
